queries: WITH per_site AS (SELECT p."zoneref", s."entrystat", AVG(p."memusagegb") AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(p."procgpu" AS numeric) / NULLIF(p."proccpu", 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM "scanprocessing" AS p JOIN "sites" AS s ON s."zoneregistry" = p."zoneref" WHERE p."memusagegb" >= 60.8 GROUP BY p."zoneref", s."entrystat") SELECT "entrystat", AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY "entrystat"

WITH per_site AS (SELECT p."zoneref", s."entrystat", AVG(p."memusagegb") AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(p."procgpu" AS numeric) / NULLIF(p."proccpu", 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM "scanprocessing" AS p JOIN "sites" AS s ON s."zoneregistry" = p."zoneref" WHERE p."memusagegb" > 60.8 GROUP BY p."zoneref", s."entrystat") SELECT "entrystat", AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM per_site GROUP BY "entrystat"

WITH site_averages AS (SELECT p.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(p.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * p.procgpu / NULLIF(p.proccpu, 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref WHERE p.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_site_ram, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_averages GROUP BY entrystat;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff includes runs using exactly 60.8 GB. A zero CPU usage makes the ratio undefined and is ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: Memory-heavy means strictly more than 60.8 GB.
